title.zh: 卷八十四 晉書10: 少帝本紀四
title.en: Volume 84 Book of Later Jin 10: Emperor Shao 3
title.raw: 卷八十四 晉書10: 少帝本紀四 Volume 84 Book of Later Jin 10: Emperor Shao 3

sentences.zh: 開運二年夏五月丙申朔，帝御崇元殿受朝，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, first day bingchen of the second year of Kaiyun, the Emperor went to Chongyuan Hall to receive court, and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day (bingchen) of the fifth month in summer of the second Kaiyun year, the Emperor took audience at Chongyuan Hall and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以右衛上將軍馬萬為左金吾上將軍致仕。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Ma Wan, General-in-Chief of the Right Guard, was made General-in-Chief of the Left Golden Guard and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Ma Wan, commanding general of the Right Guard, was appointed general-in-chief of the Left Golden Guard and retired from active duty.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，陜州節度使宋彥筠移鎮鄧州，澶州節度使何建移鎮河陽。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Song Yanyun, Military Governor of Shaan Prefecture, was transferred to Deng Prefecture; He Jian, Military Governor of Chan Prefecture, was transferred to Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Song Yanyun was moved from Shaanzhou to command Dengzhou, and He Jian from Chanzhou to Heyang.

sentences.zh: 以左神武統軍潘環為澶州節度使，以宣徽北院使李彥韜遙領壽州節度使兼侍衛馬軍都指揮使，以滄州節度使田武遙領夔州節度使兼侍衛步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Pan Huan, Commander of the Left Divine Martial Army, was made Military Governor of Chan Prefecture; Li Yantao, Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made nominal Military Governor of Shou Prefecture while also serving as Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Cavalry; Tian Wu, Military Governor of Cang Prefecture, was made nominal Military Governor of Kui Prefecture while also serving as Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Infantry.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Huan, commander of the Left Divine Martial Army, became military governor of Chanzhou; Li Yantao of the northern Secretariat bureau held Shouzhou in absentia while retaining command of the palace cavalry; and Tian Wu of Cangzhou held Kuizhou in absentia while retaining command of the palace infantry.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: On xinhai, a white rainbow crossed the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, a white rainbow was seen crossing the sun.

sentences.zh: 壬子，宰臣桑維翰、劉句、李崧、和凝並加階爵。

translations.literal: On renzi, the chief ministers Sang Weihan, Liu Xu, Li Song, and He Ning were all advanced in rank and title.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, chief ministers Sang Weihan, Liu Xu, Li Song, and He Ning all received promotions in rank and enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書竇貞固改刑部尚書，太常寺卿王松改工部尚書。

translations.literal: Dou Zhengu, Minister of Rites, was changed to Minister of Justice; Wang Song, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was changed to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Zhengu moved from the Ministry of Rites to the Ministry of Justice, and Wang Song from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 以尚書左丞龍敏為太常卿；

translations.literal: Long Min, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices;
translations.idiomatic: Long Min, left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices;

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士承旨、兵部侍郎李慎儀為尚書左丞；

translations.literal: Li Shenyi, Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin Academy and Vice Minister of War, was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Li Shenyi, expositor-in-chief of the Hanlin Academy and vice minister of war, became left vice director of the Department of State Affairs;

sentences.zh: 以御史中丞張允為兵部侍郎、知制誥，充翰林學士承旨；

translations.literal: Zhang Yun, Censor-in-Chief, was made Vice Minister of War with charge of drafting edicts, and served as Academician Expositor-in-Chief of the Hanlin Academy;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yun, censor-in-chief, was made vice minister of war with charge of drafting edicts and appointed expositor-in-chief of the Hanlin Academy;

sentences.zh: 以左諫議大夫顏衎為御史中丞；

translations.literal: Yan Yan, Left Remonstrance Grand Master, was made Censor-in-Chief;
translations.idiomatic: Yan Yan, left remonstrance grand master, was appointed censor-in-chief;

sentences.zh: （《宋史·顏衎傳》：喪亂之後，朝綱不振，衎執憲頗有風采，嘗上言：「才除御史者旋授外藩賓佐，復有以私故細事求假外拜，州郡無參謁之儀，出入失風憲之體，漸恐四方得以輕易，百辟無所準繩。

translations.literal: (Biography of Yan Yan in the History of Song: After the disorders, court discipline was slack; Yan, in enforcing the law, showed considerable authority. He once memorialized: "Those just appointed censors are soon given posts as staff to outer prefectures; others seek leave for minor private matters to take outside appointments. Prefectures have no protocol for receiving them, and their comings and goings fall short of censorial dignity. Gradually the regions may take them lightly, and the hundred officials will have no standard."
translations.idiomatic: (From the Biography of Yan Yan in the History of Song: After the upheavals, court discipline had slackened, yet Yan enforced the law with real authority. He once submitted: "Censors are appointed one day and sent the next as staff to provincial governors; others use petty private pretexts to seek outside posts on leave. The prefectures have no proper protocol for receiving them, and their movements no longer match censorial dignity. Before long the provinces will hold the office cheap, and the bureaucracy will lack a standard."

sentences.zh: 請自今藩鎮幕僚，勿得任臺官；

translations.literal: I request that from now on staff of military governors may not hold censorial posts;
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth, let no staff member of a military governor hold a censorial post;

sentences.zh: 雖親王宰相出鎮，亦不得奏充賓佐；

translations.literal: even when imperial princes or chief ministers go out to command, they may not be recommended as staff;
translations.idiomatic: even when princes or chief ministers take provincial commands, they must not be recommended as staff;

sentences.zh: 非奉制勘事，勿得出京；

translations.literal: unless commissioned by imperial order to investigate a matter, they may not leave the capital;
translations.idiomatic: and unless commissioned by imperial order to investigate a case, censors may not leave the capital;

sentences.zh: 自余不令釐雜務。

translations.literal: as for the rest, do not allow them to take on miscellaneous duties.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond that, do not let them take on miscellaneous duties.

sentences.zh: 」詔惟辟召入幕，余從其請。）〉

translations.literal: " An edict approved only summons into staff service; the rest followed his request.)]
translations.idiomatic: " An edict allowed only direct summons into a governor's staff; the rest of his request was granted.)]

sentences.zh: 以兵部侍郎、宏文館學士、判館事田敏為國子祭酒；

translations.literal: Tian Min, Vice Minister of War, Academician of the Hongwen Institute, and Administrator of the Institute, was made Chancellor of the Directorate of Education;
translations.idiomatic: Tian Min, vice minister of war, Hongwen academician, and institute administrator, was appointed chancellor of the Directorate of Education;

sentences.zh: 以戶部侍郎段希堯為兵部侍郎；

translations.literal: Duan Xiyao, Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Vice Minister of War;
translations.idiomatic: Duan Xiyao, vice minister of revenue, became vice minister of war;

sentences.zh: 以工部侍郎邊蔚為戶部侍郎，依前權知開封府事；

translations.literal: Bian Wei, Vice Minister of Works, was made Vice Minister of Revenue, continuing as before to serve as acting Administrator of Kaifeng Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Bian Wei, vice minister of works, became vice minister of revenue while continuing as acting administrator of Kaifeng;

sentences.zh: 以左散騎常侍李式為工部侍郎；

translations.literal: Li Shi, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, was made Vice Minister of Works;
translations.idiomatic: Li Shi, left attendant of the cavalry, was made vice minister of works;

sentences.zh: 以給事中王仁裕為左散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Wang Renyu, Attendant-in-Ordinary, was made Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Renyu, attendant-in-ordinary, was appointed left attendant of the cavalry.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以華州節度使趙瑩為開封尹，以皇弟開封尹重睿為秦州節度使，以宣徽南院使劉繼勛為華州節度使，以前鄆州節度使張從恩為晉州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Zhao Ying, Military Governor of Hua Prefecture, was made Administrator of Kaifeng; the Emperor's younger brother Chongrui, Administrator of Kaifeng, was made Military Governor of Qin Prefecture; Liu Jixun, Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made Military Governor of Hua Prefecture; Zhang Cong'en, former Military Governor of Yan Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Zhao Ying moved from Huazhou to administer Kaifeng; the Emperor's younger brother Chongrui left Kaifeng for Qinzhou; Liu Jixun of the southern Secretariat bureau took Huazhou; and Zhang Cong'en, former governor of Yanzhou, took Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，杜威來朝。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Du Wei came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Du Wei presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 定州奏，大風雹，北嶽廟殿宇樹木悉摧拔之。

translations.literal: Ding Prefecture reported that in a great wind and hail, the halls and trees of the Northern Sacred Peak temple were all uprooted and destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Dingzhou reported that a violent hailstorm had uprooted the halls and trees of the Northern Sacred Peak temple.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑朔，帝御崇元殿，百官入閣。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, first day yichou, the Emperor went to Chongyuan Hall; the hundred officials entered the inner court.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day (yichou) of the sixth month, the Emperor attended Chongyuan Hall while the officials entered the inner court.

sentences.zh: 監修國史劉句、史官張昭遠等以新修《唐書》紀、誌、列傳並目錄凡二百三卷上之。

translations.literal: Liu Xu, Supervisor of the Compilation of the National History, Zhang Zhaoyuan the historiographer, and others presented the newly compiled Tang History—annals, treatises, biographies, and catalogue—in all 203 juan.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xu, supervisor of the national history, the historiographer Zhang Zhaoyuan, and others presented the newly compiled Tang History—annals, treatises, biographies, and catalogue—in 203 juan.

sentences.zh: 賜器帛有差。

translations.literal: Vessels and silks were bestowed in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards of vessels and silks were granted in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以恒州節度使杜威為天雄軍節度使，充鄴都留守；

translations.literal: On guiyou, Du Wei, Military Governor of Heng Prefecture, was made Military Governor of the Tianxiong Army and served as Garrison Commander of the Ye capital;
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Du Wei was transferred from Hengzhou to command the Tianxiong army and serve as garrison commander of the Ye capital;

sentences.zh: 以鄴都留守馬全節為恒州節度使；

translations.literal: Ma Quanjie, Garrison Commander of the Ye capital, was made Military Governor of Heng Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Ma Quanjie, garrison commander of the Ye capital, was made military governor of Hengzhou;

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、金部郎中、知制誥徐臺符為中書舍人；

translations.literal: Xu Taifu, Hanlin Academician, Director of the Bureau of Metals, and drafter of edicts, was made Secretariat Drafter;
translations.idiomatic: Xu Taifu, Hanlin academician, director of the Bureau of Metals, and edict drafter, was appointed secretariat drafter;

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、禮部郎中、知制誥李瀚為中書舍人；

translations.literal: Li Han, Hanlin Academician, Director of the Bureau of Rites, and drafter of edicts, was made Secretariat Drafter;
translations.idiomatic: Li Han, Hanlin academician, director of the Bureau of Rites, and edict drafter, was appointed secretariat drafter;

sentences.zh: 翰林學士、都官郎中劉溫叟加知制誥；

translations.literal: Liu Wensou, Hanlin Academician and Director of the Bureau of Justice, was additionally given charge of drafting edicts;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wensou, Hanlin academician and director of the Bureau of Justice, was additionally charged with drafting edicts;

sentences.zh: 翰林學士、主客員外郎範質改比部郎中、知制誥，並依舊充職；

translations.literal: Fan Zhi, Hanlin Academician and Vice Director of the Bureau of Guests, was changed to Director of the Bureau of Audits with charge of drafting edicts, and continued in his former duties;
translations.idiomatic: Fan Zhi, Hanlin academician and vice director of the Bureau of Guests, was made director of the Bureau of Audits with charge of drafting edicts while retaining his other duties;

sentences.zh: 祠部員外郎、知制誥張沆本官充學士；

translations.literal: Zhang Hong, Vice Director of the Bureau of Sacrifices with charge of drafting edicts, served as academician in his original office;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hong, vice director of the Bureau of Sacrifices with charge of drafting edicts, was appointed academician at his existing rank;

sentences.zh: 以太常少卿陶穀為中書舍人。

translations.literal: Tao Gu, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Gu, vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was appointed secretariat drafter.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·陶穀傳》：穀性急率，嘗與兗帥安審信集會，杯酒相失，為審信所奏，時方姑息武臣，穀坐責授太常少卿。

translations.literal: (Biography of Tao Gu in the History of Song: Gu was by nature hasty and blunt. Once at a gathering with Yan military governor An Shenxin, a dispute over wine led to Shenxin's memorial against him; the court was then indulgent toward military men, and Gu was punished by appointment as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Biography of Tao Gu in the History of Song: Gu was brusque by nature. At a gathering with Yanzhou governor An Shenxin, a quarrel over wine led to Shenxin's memorial; the court was then indulgent toward military men, and Gu was demoted to vice director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 嘗上言：「頃蒞西臺，每見臺司詳斷刑獄，少有即時決者。

translations.literal: He once memorialized: "When I recently served at the Western Terrace, I often saw the censorate review criminal cases, yet few were decided on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: He once submitted: "When I recently served at the Western Terrace, I saw the censorate review criminal cases, yet few were decided promptly.

sentences.zh: 至於閭閻夫婦，小有爭訟，淹滯即時；

translations.literal: As for common couples in the lanes with minor disputes, delay was immediate;
translations.idiomatic: Ordinary couples in the lanes with petty disputes were delayed at once;

sentences.zh: 坊市死亡喪葬，必候臺司判狀；

translations.literal: deaths and burials in wards and markets had to await the censorate's written judgment;
translations.idiomatic: deaths and burials in the wards and markets had to await a written ruling from the censorate;

sentences.zh: 奴婢病亡，亦須檢驗。

translations.literal: when slaves and maidservants died of illness, examination was also required.
translations.idiomatic: and when slaves or maidservants died of illness, examination was required as well.

sentences.zh: 吏因緣為奸，而邀求不已，經旬不獲埋瘞。

translations.literal: Clerks used the opportunity for wrongdoing and made endless demands; for ten days burial was not obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks seized the chance for extortion and endless demands, so burials could be delayed ten days or more.

sentences.zh: 望申條約，以革其弊。

translations.literal: I hope regulations may be promulgated to reform these abuses.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that clear regulations be issued to end these abuses.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 俄拜中書舍人。）〉

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Secretariat Drafter.)]
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was appointed secretariat drafter.)]

sentences.zh: 己亥，以邠州節度使劉景巖為陜州節度使。

translations.literal: On jihai, Liu Jingyan, Military Governor of Bin Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Shaan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Liu Jingyan was transferred from Binzhou to Shaanzhou.

sentences.zh: 己卯，新授恒州節度使馬全節卒，輟朝，贈中書令。

translations.literal: On jimao, Ma Quanjie, newly appointed Military Governor of Heng Prefecture, died; court audiences were suspended; he was posthumously made Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Ma Quanjie, newly appointed to Hengzhou, died; court audiences were suspended, and he was posthumously made grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 壬午，大理卿張仁願卒，贈秘書監。

translations.literal: On renwu, Zhang Renyuan, Director of the Court of Judicial Review, died; he was posthumously made Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Zhang Renyuan, director of the Court of Judicial Review, died and was posthumously made director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 遣刑部尚書竇貞固等分詣寺觀禱雨。

translations.literal: Dou Zhengu, Minister of Justice, and others were dispatched separately to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Zhengu, minister of justice, and others were sent to temples and monasteries throughout the realm to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以定州節度使王周為恒州節度使，以前易州刺史安審約為定州留後。

translations.literal: On jichou, Wang Zhou, Military Governor of Ding Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Heng Prefecture; An Shenyue, former Prefect of Yi Prefecture, was made Garrison Deputy of Ding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Wang Zhou moved from Dingzhou to Hengzhou, and An Shenyue, former prefect of Yizhou, became garrison deputy of Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，兩京及州郡十五並奏旱。

translations.literal: That month, both capitals and fifteen prefectures all reported drought.
translations.idiomatic: That month, both capitals and fifteen prefectures reported drought.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙未朔，以侍衛步軍都指揮使、領夔州節度使田武為昭義軍節度使。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, first day yiwei, Tian Wu, Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Infantry and nominal Military Governor of Kui Prefecture, was made Military Governor of the Zhaoyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day (yiwei) of the seventh month in autumn, Tian Wu, commander of the palace infantry who also held Kuizhou, was appointed military governor of the Zhaoyi army.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，左諫議大夫李元龜奏，請禁止天下僧尼典買院舍，從之。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Li Yuan'gui, Left Remonstrance Grand Master, memorialized requesting a ban on monks and nuns throughout the realm mortgaging and purchasing monastic compounds; the request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Li Yuan'gui, left remonstrance grand master, asked that monks and nuns be forbidden to mortgage or buy monastic compounds nationwide; the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，前少府監李楷貶坊州司戶，坐冒請逃死吏人衣糧入己故也。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Li Kai, former Director of the Palace Workshops, was demoted to Registrar of Fang Prefecture, because he had falsely claimed clothing and grain rations for clerks who had fled or died and kept them for himself.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Li Kai, former director of the palace workshops, was demoted to registrar of Fangzhou for falsely claiming rations for clerks who had fled or died and keeping them for himself.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以前齊州防禦使薛可言為延州兵馬留後。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Xue Keyan, former Defense Commissioner of Qi Prefecture, was made Garrison Deputy for Troops and Horses of Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Xue Keyan, former defense commissioner of Qizhou, was appointed garrison deputy for troops and horses at Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, first day jiazi, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day (jiazi) of the eighth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 中書舍人陶穀奏，請權廢太常寺二舞郎。

translations.literal: Tao Gu, Secretariat Drafter, memorialized requesting the provisional abolition of the two dance officers of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Tao Gu, secretariat drafter, asked that the two dance officers of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices be provisionally abolished.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，宰臣和凝罷相，守右僕射。

translations.literal: On bingyin, chief minister He Ning left the chancellorship and remained as Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, chief minister He Ning left the chancellorship and remained as right vice director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 以樞密使馮玉為中書侍郎、平章事，使如故。

translations.literal: Feng Yu, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor; his commission continued as before.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yu, commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made vice director of the Secretariat and grand councilor while retaining his existing commission.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔：「諸御史今後除準式請假外，不得以細故小事請假離京；

translations.literal: On yihai, an edict stated: "Henceforth, except for leave according to standard regulations, censors may not request leave from the capital for minor trifles;
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, an edict declared: "Henceforth, except for leave under the standard regulations, censors may not leave the capital on leave for petty private matters;

sentences.zh: 除奉制命差推事及按察外，不得以諸雜細務差出。

translations.literal: except when commissioned by imperial order to investigate or inspect, they may not be dispatched on various miscellaneous minor duties."
translations.idiomatic: nor may they be dispatched on miscellaneous minor duties except when commissioned by imperial order to investigate or inspect."

sentences.zh: 」丙子，以靈州節度使馮暉為邠州節度使，加檢校太尉；

translations.literal: On bingzi, Feng Hui, Military Governor of Ling Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Bin Prefecture and given the additional title of Grand Preceptor;
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Feng Hui was transferred from Lingzhou to Binzhou and given the additional title of grand preceptor;

sentences.zh: 以前鄜州節度使丁審琪為左羽林統軍；

translations.literal: Ding Shenqi, former Military Governor of Fu Prefecture, was made Commander of the Left Forest of Feathers;
translations.idiomatic: Ding Shenqi, former governor of Fuzhou, was made commander of the Left Forest of Feathers;

sentences.zh: 以前鄜州節度使郭謹為左神武統軍。

translations.literal: Guo Jin, former Military Governor of Fu Prefecture, was made Commander of the Left Divine Martial Army.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Jin, former governor of Fuzhou, was made commander of the Left Divine Martial Army.

sentences.zh: 西京留司御史臺奏：「新授鄧州節度使宋彥筠於銀沙灘斬廳頭鄭溫。

translations.literal: The Western Capital's resident censorate reported: "Song Yanyun, newly appointed Military Governor of Deng Prefecture, executed at Yinsha Beach his chief clerk Zheng Wen."
translations.idiomatic: The Western Capital's resident censorate reported: "Song Yanyun, newly appointed to Dengzhou, executed his chief clerk Zheng Wen at Yinsha Beach."

sentences.zh: 」詔鞫之，款云：「彥筠出身軍旅，不知事體，不合專擅行法。

translations.literal: An edict ordered investigation; the confession stated: "Yanyun came from the military and did not understand proper procedure; he should not have exercised the law on his own authority."
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered an inquiry; the confession read: "Yanyun came from the military ranks and did not understand proper procedure; he should not have executed the law on his own authority."

sentences.zh: 」詔釋其罪。

translations.literal: An edict released him from punishment.
translations.idiomatic: An edict pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 以工部尚書王松權知貢舉。

translations.literal: Wang Song, Minister of Works, was made acting Superintendent of the Civil Service Examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Song, minister of works, was appointed acting superintendent of the civil service examinations.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以前晉州節度使安叔千為右金吾上將軍；

translations.literal: On dingchou, An Shuqian, former Military Governor of Jin Prefecture, was made General-in-Chief of the Right Golden Guard;
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, An Shuqian, former governor of Jinzhou, was made general-in-chief of the Right Golden Guard;

sentences.zh: 以三司副使、給事中李穀為磁州刺史，充北面水陸轉運使。

translations.literal: Li Gu, Deputy Commissioner of the Three Departments and Attendant-in-Ordinary, was made Prefect of Ci Prefecture and served as Northern Frontier Commissioner for Water and Land Transport.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gu, deputy commissioner of the Three Departments and attendant-in-ordinary, was made prefect of Cizhou and commissioner for water and land transport on the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 分遣使臣於諸道率馬。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched separately to the various circuits to levy horses.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to the various circuits to levy horses.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以左金吾上將軍皇甫立為左衛上將軍，以右羽林統軍李懷忠為左武衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Huangfu Li, General-in-Chief of the Left Golden Guard, was made General-in-Chief of the Left Guard; Li Huaizhong, Commander of the Right Forest of Feathers, was made General-in-Chief of the Left Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Huangfu Li moved from the Left Golden Guard to command the Left Guard, and Li Huaizhong from the Right Forest of Feathers to the Left Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，新授潞州節度使田武卒，輟朝，贈太尉。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Tian Wu, newly appointed Military Governor of Lu Prefecture, died; court audiences were suspended; he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Tian Wu, newly appointed to Luzhou, died; court audiences were suspended, and he was posthumously made grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，湖南奏，靜江軍節度使馬希杲卒。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Hunan reported that Ma Xigao, Military Governor of the Jingjiang Army, had died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Hunan reported the death of Ma Xigao, military governor of the Jingjiang army.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，以西京留守、北面馬步軍都排陣使景延廣為北面行營副招討使。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingshen, Jing Yanguang, Western Capital Garrison Commander and Northern Frontier Commander for Arraying Horse and Foot Forces, was made Deputy Pacification Commissioner of the Northern Frontier Field Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the ninth month, Jing Yanguang, Western Capital garrison commander and northern frontier array commander for horse and foot, was made deputy pacification commissioner of the northern frontier headquarters.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以刑部侍郎趙遠為戶部侍郎，以工部侍郎李式為刑部侍郎，以中書舍人盧價為工部侍郎。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Zhao Yuan, Vice Minister of Justice, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Li Shi, Vice Minister of Works, was made Vice Minister of Justice; Lu Jia, Secretariat Drafter, was made Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Zhao Yuan moved from justice to revenue, Li Shi from works to justice, and Lu Jia from the secretariat to works.

sentences.zh: 價久次綸闈，舊例合轉禮部侍郎或御史中丞，宰臣馮玉擬此官，桑維翰以為資望淺，不署狀。

translations.literal: Jia had long served in the drafting office; by precedent he should have been transferred to Vice Minister of Rites or Censor-in-Chief. Chief minister Feng Yu proposed these offices, but Sang Weihan considered his seniority shallow and would not sign the appointment document.
translations.idiomatic: Jia had long served in the drafting office and by precedent should have risen to vice minister of rites or censor-in-chief. Feng Yu proposed those posts, but Sang Weihan judged his seniority insufficient and refused to sign the appointment.

sentences.zh: 無何，維翰休沐數日，玉獨奏行之，維翰由是不樂，與玉有間矣。

translations.literal: Before long, while Weihan was on leave for several days, Yu alone memorialized and carried it through; Weihan was displeased thereby, and there was estrangement between him and Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, while Weihan was on leave for several days, Yu memorialized alone and had the appointment carried through. Weihan was displeased, and a rift opened between him and Yu.

sentences.zh: 己亥，幸繁臺觀馬，遂幸李守貞第。

translations.literal: On jihai, the Emperor visited Fanta to view horses, then visited the residence of Li Shouzhen.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the Emperor visited Fantai to watch horses, then called at Li Shouzhen's residence.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以晉州節度使張從恩為潞州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Zhang Cong'en, Military Governor of Jin Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Zhang Cong'en was transferred from Jinzhou to Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎張昭遠加階爵，酬修《唐史》之勞也。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of Personnel, was advanced in rank and title, in reward for labor on the Tang History.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhaoyuan, vice minister of personnel, was advanced in rank and title as reward for compiling the Tang History.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·張昭遠傳》：加金紫階，進爵邑。）〉

translations.literal: (Biography of Zhang Zhaoyuan in the History of Song: He was advanced to the gold-and-purple rank and promoted in enfeoffment.)]
translations.idiomatic: (From the Biography of Zhang Zhaoyuan in the History of Song: He was advanced to the gold-and-purple rank and promoted in enfeoffment.)]

sentences.zh: 戊申，升曹州為節鎮，以威信軍為軍額。

translations.literal: On wushen, Cao Prefecture was elevated to a military governorship; Weixin Army was made the army designation.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Caozhou was elevated to a military governorship under the army name Weixin.

sentences.zh: 詔李守貞率兵屯澶州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Li Shouzhen to lead troops and garrison Chan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Li Shouzhen to lead troops and encamp at Chanzhou.

sentences.zh: 己酉，月掩昴宿。

translations.literal: On jiyou, the moon occulted the Mao constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the moon occulted the Mao constellation.

sentences.zh: 以宣徽北院使焦繼勛為宣徽南院使，以內客省使孟承誨為宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: Jiao Jixun, Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made Commissioner of the Southern Bureau; Meng Chenghui, Commissioner of the Inner Service Directorate, was made Commissioner of the Northern Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Jiao Jixun moved from the northern to the southern Secretariat bureau, and Meng Chenghui from the Inner Service Directorate to the northern bureau.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以前太子詹事王居敏為鴻臚卿，李專美為大理卿，以太子賓客致仕馬裔孫為太子詹事。

translations.literal: On renzi, Wang Jumin, former Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Director of the Court of State Ceremonial; Li Zhuanmei was made Director of the Court of Judicial Review; Ma Yisun, retired Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Wang Jumin, former grand mentor of the heir apparent, became director of the Court of State Ceremonial; Li Zhuanmei became director of the Court of Judicial Review; and Ma Yisun, retired grand mentor of the heir apparent, was reappointed grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，移泰州理所於滿城縣。

translations.literal: On jiayin, the administrative seat of Tai Prefecture was moved to Mancheng County.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the administrative seat of Taizhou was moved to Mancheng County.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔相州節度使張彥澤率兵屯恒州。

translations.literal: On yimao, an edict ordered Zhang Yanzhe, Military Governor of Xiang Prefecture, to lead troops and garrison Heng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, an edict ordered Zhang Yanzhe of Xiangzhou to lead troops and encamp at Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，以河陽節度使何建為涇州節度使，以許州節度使李從溫為河陽節度使，以前鄭州節度使石赟為曹州節度使。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on wuyin, He Jian, Military Governor of Heyang, was made Military Governor of Jing Prefecture; Li Congwen, Military Governor of Xu Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Heyang; Shi Yun, former Military Governor of Zheng Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Cao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the tenth month of winter, He Jian moved from Heyang to Jingzhou, Li Congwen from Xuzhou to Heyang, and Shi Yun, former governor of Zhengzhou, took Caozhou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遣使太子賓客羅周嶽、使副太子右庶子王延濟冊兩浙節度使錢宏佐為守太尉。

translations.literal: On gengwu, envoys were dispatched: chief envoy Luo Zhouyue, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, and deputy envoy Wang Yanji, Right Vice Director of the Heir Apparent's Household, to invest Qian Hongzuo, Military Governor of the Two Zhes, as Acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Luo Zhouyue, grand mentor of the heir apparent, and Wang Yanji, right vice director of the heir apparent's household, were dispatched to invest Qian Hongzuo, military governor of the Two Zhes, as acting grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 辛未，右金吾衛上將軍楊彥詢卒，贈太子太師。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Yang Yanxun, General-in-Chief of the Right Golden Guard, died; he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Yang Yanxun, general-in-chief of the Right Golden Guard, died and was posthumously made grand preceptor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，高麗遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Goryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Goryeo sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以前延州節度使王令溫為靈州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Wang Lingwen, former Military Governor of Yan Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Ling Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Wang Lingwen, former governor of Yanzhou, was appointed military governor of Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以邢州兵馬留後劉在明為晉州兵馬留後，以前河陽留後方太為邢州留後。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Liu Zaiming, Garrison Deputy for Troops and Horses of Xing Prefecture, was made Garrison Deputy for Troops and Horses of Jin Prefecture; Fang Tai, former Garrison Deputy of Heyang, was made Garrison Deputy of Xing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Liu Zaiming moved from Xingzhou to serve as garrison deputy for troops and horses at Jinzhou, and Fang Tai, former Heyang deputy, took Xingzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，升陳州為節鎮，以鎮安軍為軍額。

translations.literal: On guisi, Chen Prefecture was elevated to a military governorship; Zhen'an Army was made the army designation.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Chenzhou was elevated to a military governorship under the army name Zhen'an.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，以邠州節度使馮暉兼侍衛步軍都指揮使，充北面行營先鋒馬步軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuxu, Feng Hui, Military Governor of Bin Prefecture, was additionally made Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Infantry and appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Vanguard Combined Cavalry and Infantry of the Northern Expeditionary Command;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuxu, Feng Hui, military governor of Binzhou, was additionally made commander-in-chief of the palace infantry and appointed commander-in-chief of the vanguard combined cavalry and infantry of the northern expeditionary command;

sentences.zh: 以權知高麗國事王武為檢校太保、使持節、玄菟州都督，充大義軍使，封高麗國王。

translations.literal: Wang Wu, who held provisional charge of Goryeo affairs, was made Honorary Grand Guardian, Commissioner with Full Credentials, Military Commissioner of Xuanyuan Prefecture, appointed Commissioner of the Dayi Army, and enfeoffed as King of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wu, who held provisional charge of Goryeo affairs, was made honorary grand guardian, commissioner with full credentials, and military commissioner of Xuanyuan Prefecture, appointed commissioner of the Dayi Army, and enfeoffed as king of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，日南至，帝御崇元殿受朝賀。

translations.literal: On guimao, the winter solstice, the Emperor went to Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the winter solstice, the Emperor attended Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations.

sentences.zh: 戊申，兩浙奏，順化軍節度使錢鐸卒。

translations.literal: On wushen, Liangzhe reported that Qian Duo, Military Governor of the Shunhua Army, had died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Liangzhe reported that Qian Duo, military governor of the Shunhua Army, had died.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以壽州節度使、侍衛馬軍都指揮使李彥韜為陳州節度使，典軍如故。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Li Yantao, Military Governor of Shou Prefecture and Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Cavalry, was made Military Governor of Chen Prefecture, continuing in his military duties as before.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Li Yantao, military governor of Shouzhou and commander-in-chief of the palace cavalry, was made military governor of Chenzhou while retaining his military command.

sentences.zh: 丙申，前商州刺史李俊除名，坐受財枉法也。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Li Jun, former Prefect of Shang Prefecture, was struck from the rolls for accepting bribes and perverting the law.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Li Jun, former prefect of Shangzhou, was struck from the rolls for accepting bribes and perverting the law.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，以兩浙節度使、吳越國王錢宏佐兼東南面兵馬都元帥。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yichou, Qian Hongzuo, Military Governor of Liangzhe and King of Wuyue, was additionally made Grand Marshal of the Southeastern Army and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yichou, Qian Hongzuo, military governor of Liangzhe and king of Wuyue, was additionally made grand marshal of the southeastern army and cavalry.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以吳越國金馬左廂都指揮使、湖州刺史胡思進遙領虔州昭信軍節度使，以吳越國金馬右廂都指揮使、明州刺史闞璠遙領宣州寧國軍節度使，並典軍如故。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Hu Sijin, Commander of the Left Wing of the Wuyue Golden Horse Guards and Prefect of Hu Prefecture, held Gan Prefecture's Zhaoxin Army in absentia as military governor; Kan Fan, Commander of the Right Wing of the Wuyue Golden Horse Guards and Prefect of Ming Prefecture, held Xuan Prefecture's Ningguo Army in absentia as military governor; both continued in their military duties as before.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Hu Sijin, commander of the left wing of the Wuyue Golden Horse Guards and prefect of Huzhou, held Ganzhou's Zhaoxin army in absentia as military governor; Kan Fan, commander of the right wing of the Wuyue Golden Horse Guards and prefect of Mingzhou, held Xuanzhou's Ningguo army in absentia as military governor; both retained their military commands.

sentences.zh: 左羽林統軍丁審琪卒，贈太尉。

translations.literal: Ding Shenqi, Commander of the Left Feathered Forest Army, died; he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Shenqi, commander of the Left Feathered Forest Army, died and was posthumously made grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以工部侍郎盧價為禮部侍郎，以右散騎常侍、集賢殿學士、判院事司徒詡為工部侍郎，依前充職；

translations.literal: On xinwei, Lu Jia, Vice Minister of Works, was made Vice Minister of Rites; Situ Xu, Right Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and Administrator of the Academy, was made Vice Minister of Works, continuing in his former duties;
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Lu Jia, vice minister of works, was made vice minister of rites; Situ Xu, right regular attendant of the cavalry, academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and administrator of the academy, was made vice minister of works while retaining his other duties;

sentences.zh: 以前中書舍人殷鵬為給事中，充樞密直學士；

translations.literal: Yin Peng, former Secretariat Drafter, was made Supervising Censor and appointed Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Yin Peng, former secretariat drafter, was made supervising censor and appointed academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs;

sentences.zh: 以給事中劉知新為右散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Liu Zhixin, Supervising Censor, was made Right Regular Attendant of the Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zhixin, supervising censor, was made right regular attendant of the cavalry.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，陜府節度使劉景巖來朝。

translations.literal: On yihai, Liu Jingyan, Military Governor of Shaan Prefecture, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Liu Jingyan, military governor of Shaan Prefecture, presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，狩於近郊，獵也。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs—a hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 己卯，光祿卿致仕陳元卒於太原。

translations.literal: On jimao, Chen Yuan, Retired Director of the Directorate of Banquets, died at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Chen Yuan, retired director of the Directorate of Banquets, died at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命使冊高麗國王王武。

translations.literal: On gengchen, envoys were dispatched to invest Wang Wu as King of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, envoys were dispatched to invest Wang Wu as king of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以前兗州節度使安審信為華州節度使。

translations.literal: On guiwei, An Shenxin, former Military Governor of Yan Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Hua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, An Shenxin, former military governor of Yanzhou, was made military governor of Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以樞密使、中書令桑維翰為開封尹；

translations.literal: On dinghai, Sang Weihan, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Grand Councilor, was made Administrator of Kaifeng;
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Sang Weihan, commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and grand councilor, was made administrator of Kaifeng;

sentences.zh: 以司空、門下侍郎、平章事劉句判三司；

translations.literal: Liu Xu, Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Councilor, was put in charge of the Three Offices;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xu, minister of works, vice director of the chancellery, and councilor, was put in charge of the Three Offices;

sentences.zh: 以左僕射、門下侍郎、平章事李崧為守侍中，充樞密使；

translations.literal: Li Song, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, Vice Director of the Chancellery, and Councilor, was made Acting Chief Councilor and appointed Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Li Song, left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, vice director of the chancellery, and councilor, was made acting chief councilor and appointed commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs;

sentences.zh: 以開封尹趙瑩為中書令、宏文館大學士；

translations.literal: Zhao Ying, Administrator of Kaifeng, was made Grand Councilor and Grand Academician of the Hongwen Institute;
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Ying, administrator of Kaifeng, was made grand councilor and grand academician of the Hongwen Institute;

sentences.zh: 以宣徽南院使焦繼勛知陜州軍州事。

translations.literal: Jiao Jixun, Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made provisional administrator of Shaan Prefecture military and civil affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Jiao Jixun, commissioner of the southern bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made provisional administrator of Shaan Prefecture military and civil affairs.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·焦繼勛傳》：西人寇邊，朝議發師致討，繼勛抗疏請行，拜秦州觀察使兼諸蕃水陸轉運使。

translations.literal: (From the Biography of Jiao Jixun in the History of Song: When western tribes raided the frontier, the court debated sending troops to attack; Jixun submitted a bold memorial requesting to go and was appointed Military Commissioner of Qin Prefecture and concurrently Commissioner for Overland and Water Transport among the Various Tribes.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Biography of Jiao Jixun in the History of Song: When western tribes raided the frontier, the court debated sending troops to attack; Jixun submitted a bold memorial requesting to go and was appointed military commissioner of Qin Prefecture and concurrently commissioner for overland and water transport among the various tribes.

sentences.zh: 既至，推恩信，設方略，招誘諸部，相率奉玉帛牛酒乞盟，邊境以安。

translations.literal: Once there, he extended kindness and trust, devised strategy, and recruited the various tribes; they came in succession bearing jade, silk, cattle, and wine to request alliance, and the frontier was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Once there, he extended kindness and trust, devised strategy, and won over the various tribes; they came in succession bearing jade, silk, cattle, and wine to request alliance, and the frontier was settled.

sentences.zh: 俄徙知陜州。）〉

translations.literal: Soon after he was transferred to administer Shaan Prefecture.)]
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was transferred to administer Shaan Prefecture.)]

sentences.zh: 己丑，邠州節度使馮暉準詔來朝。

translations.literal: On jichou, Feng Hui, Military Governor of Bin Prefecture, came to court in accordance with an edict.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Feng Hui, military governor of Binzhou, came to court in accordance with an edict.

sentences.zh: 是歲，帝每遇四方進獻器皿，多以銀於外府易金而入，謂左右曰：「金者貴而且輕，便於人力。

translations.literal: That year, whenever the Emperor received vessels presented from the four directions, he often had silver exchanged for gold at outer treasuries and brought the gold in. He said to those around him: "Gold is precious yet light, convenient for human labor.
translations.idiomatic: That year, whenever the Emperor received vessels presented from the four directions, he often had silver exchanged for gold at outer treasuries and brought the gold in. He said to those around him: "Gold is precious yet light, convenient for human labor.

sentences.zh: 」識者以為北遷之兆也。

translations.literal: " Those with insight regarded this as an omen of northward relocation.
translations.idiomatic: " Those with insight regarded this as an omen of northward relocation.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·劉濤傳》：少帝奢侈，常以銀易金，廣其器皿。

translations.literal: (From the Biography of Liu Tao in the History of Song: The Young Emperor was extravagant and often exchanged silver for gold to enlarge his vessels.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Biography of Liu Tao in the History of Song: The Young Emperor was extravagant and often exchanged silver for gold to enlarge his vessels.

sentences.zh: 李崧判三司，令上庫金之數。

translations.literal: Li Song, overseeing the Three Offices, ordered a count of gold in the upper treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Li Song, overseeing the Three Offices, ordered a count of gold in the upper treasury.

sentences.zh: 及崧以原簿校之，少數千鎰。

translations.literal: When Song checked against the original ledger, several thousand ingots were short.
translations.idiomatic: When Song checked against the original ledger, several thousand ingots were short.

sentences.zh: 崧責曰：「帑庫通式，一日不受虛數，毫厘則有重典。

translations.literal: Song rebuked him, saying: "Treasury regulations—never for a single day accept false counts; even a hair's breadth brings severe penalty.
translations.idiomatic: Song rebuked him, saying: "Treasury regulations—never for a single day accept false counts; even a hair's breadth brings severe penalty.

sentences.zh: 」濤曰：「帑司常有報不盡數，以備宣索。

translations.literal: " Tao said: "Treasury officers often report less than the full count to reserve against imperial demands.
translations.idiomatic: " Tao said: "Treasury officers often report less than the full count to reserve against imperial demands.

sentences.zh: 」崧令有司劾濤，濤事迫，以情告樞密使桑維翰，乃止罰一月俸。）〉

translations.literal: " Song had the authorities impeach Tao; pressed hard, Tao confided the facts to Commissioner Sang Weihan, who stopped at a one-month salary penalty.)]
translations.idiomatic: " Song had the authorities impeach Tao; pressed hard, Tao confided the facts to Commissioner Sang Weihan, who stopped at a one-month salary penalty.)]

sentences.zh: 開運三年春正月癸巳朔，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, first day guisi of the third year of Kaiyun, the Emperor went to Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations; guards and escort were as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, on the first day (guisi) of the first month of the third year of Kaiyun, the Emperor attended Chongyuan Hall to receive court congratulations; guards and escort were as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 詔改鑄天下合同印、書詔印、御前印，並以黃金為之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered recasting the realm's contract seals, edict-writing seals, and imperial-front seals, all to be made of gold.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered recasting the realm's contract seals, edict-writing seals, and imperial-front seals, all to be made of gold.

sentences.zh: 己亥，貝州梁漢璋奏，蕃寇屯聚，將謀入寇。

translations.literal: On jihai, Liang Hanzhang of Bei Prefecture reported that barbarian raiders were massing and planning an invasion.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Liang Hanzhang of Beizhou reported that barbarian raiders were massing and planning an invasion.

sentences.zh: 詔符彥卿屯荊州口。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Fu Yanqing to encamp at Jingzhoukou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Fu Yanqing to encamp at Jingzhoukou.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·符彥卿傳》：再出河朔，彥卿不與，易其行伍，配以羸師數千戍荊州口。）〉

translations.literal: (From the Biography of Fu Yanqing in the History of Song: When ordered again to the Hebei region, Yanqing declined; his troops were rearranged and he was given several thousand worn troops to garrison Jingzhoukou.)]
translations.idiomatic: (From the Biography of Fu Yanqing in the History of Song: When ordered again to the Hebei region, Yanqing declined; his troops were rearranged and he was given several thousand worn troops to garrison Jingzhoukou.)]

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以前華州節度使劉繼勛為同州節度使，以陜州節度使劉景巖為鄧州節度使。

translations.literal: On guimao, Liu Jixun, former Military Governor of Hua Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Tong Prefecture; Liu Jingyan, Military Governor of Shaan Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Liu Jixun, former military governor of Huazhou, was made military governor of Tongzhou; Liu Jingyan, military governor of Shaan Prefecture, was made military governor of Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以宣徽南院使、知陜州事焦繼勛為陜州留後。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Jiao Jixun, Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat and provisional administrator of Shaan Prefecture, was made Garrison Deputy of Shaan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Jiao Jixun, commissioner of the southern bureau of the Palace Secretariat and provisional administrator of Shaan Prefecture, was made garrison deputy of Shaan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁未，刑部員外王洧賜自家自盡，坐私用宮錢經營求利故也。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Wang Wei, Vice Director of the Ministry of Justice, was granted permission to take his own life at home for privately using palace funds to engage in profit-seeking.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Wang Wei, vice director of the Ministry of Justice, was granted permission to take his own life at home for privately using palace funds to engage in profit-seeking.

sentences.zh: 右司郎中李知損貶均州司戶，員外置，馳驛發遣，坐前任度支判官日與解縣榷鹽使王景遇交遊借貸故也。

translations.literal: Li Zhisun, Director of the Right Bureau, was demoted to Registrar of Jun Prefecture, appointed outside the regular quota, and dispatched by express relay for, during his tenure as revenue adjudicator, associating and borrowing from Wang Jingyu, Salt Monopoly Commissioner of Jie County.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhisun, director of the right bureau, was demoted to registrar of Jun Prefecture, appointed outside the regular quota, and dispatched by express relay for, during his tenure as revenue adjudicator, associating and borrowing from Wang Jingyu, salt monopoly commissioner of Jie County.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔侍衛親軍副都指揮使李守貞率師巡撫北邊。

translations.literal: On jiyou, an edict ordered Li Shouzhen, Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard, to lead troops to inspect and pacify the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, an edict ordered Li Shouzhen, deputy commander-in-chief of the palace guard, to lead troops to inspect and pacify the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以皇弟秦州節度使重睿為許州節度使，以許州節度使安審琦為兗州節度使，以兗州節度使趙在禮為晉昌軍節度使。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Emperor's younger brother Chongrui, Military Governor of Qin Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Xu Prefecture; An Shenqi, Military Governor of Xu Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Yan Prefecture; Zhao Zaili, Military Governor of Yan Prefecture, was made Military Governor of the Jinchang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the Emperor's younger brother Chongrui, military governor of Qinzhou, was made military governor of Xuzhou; An Shenqi, military governor of Xuzhou, was made military governor of Yanzhou; and Zhao Zaili, military governor of Yanzhou, was made military governor of the Jinchang Army.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以涇州節度使何建為秦州節度使，以前貝州節度使史威為涇州節度使。

translations.literal: On guichou, He Jian, Military Governor of Jing Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Qin Prefecture; Shi Wei, former Military Governor of Bei Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Jing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, He Jian, military governor of Jingzhou, was made military governor of Qinzhou; Shi Wei, former military governor of Beizhou, was made military governor of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，定州奏，契丹入寇。

translations.literal: On yimao, Ding Prefecture reported that the Khitan had invaded.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Dingzhou reported that the Khitan had invaded.

sentences.zh: 己未，二王後守太僕少卿、襲酅國公楊延壽除名配流威州，終身勿齒。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Yang Yanshou, scion of the two royal houses, Acting Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud, and inheritor Duke of Xi, was struck from the rolls, exiled to Wei Prefecture, and barred for life from official rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Yang Yanshou, scion of the two royal houses, acting vice director of the Court of the Imperial Stud, and inheritor Duke of Xi, was struck from the rolls, exiled to Weizhou, and barred for life from official rank.

sentences.zh: 延壽奉命於磁州檢苗，受贓二百餘匹，準律當絞，有司以二王後入議，故貸其死。

translations.literal: Yanshou, on assignment at Cizhou to inspect seedlings, accepted bribes of more than two hundred bolts of cloth; by law he deserved strangulation, but the authorities debated his status as scion of the two royal houses and therefore spared his life.
translations.idiomatic: Yanshou, on assignment at Cizhou to inspect seedlings, accepted bribes of more than two hundred bolts of cloth; by law he deserved strangulation, but the authorities debated his status as scion of the two royal houses and therefore spared his life.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰朔，以權知河西節度使張遵古為河西留後。

translations.literal: In the third month, first day renchen, Zhang Zungu, provisional Military Governor of Hexi, was made Garrison Deputy of Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the first day (renchen), Zhang Zungu, provisional military governor of Hexi, was made garrison deputy of Hexi.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以御史中丞顏衎為戶部侍郎，以戶部侍郎趙遠為御史中丞。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Yan Yan, Censor-in-Chief, was made Vice Minister of Revenue; Zhao Yuan, Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Yan Yan, censor-in-chief, was made vice minister of revenue; Zhao Yuan, vice minister of revenue, was made censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以邠州節度使兼侍衛步軍都指揮使馮暉為河陽節度使，以前涇州節度使李德充為邠州節度使。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Feng Hui, Military Governor of Bin Prefecture and Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Infantry, was made Military Governor of Heyang; Li Dechong, former Military Governor of Jing Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Feng Hui, military governor of Binzhou and commander-in-chief of the palace infantry, was made military governor of Heyang; Li Dechong, former military governor of Jingzhou, was made military governor of Binzhou.

sentences.zh: 李守貞奏，大軍至衡水。

translations.literal: Li Shouzhen reported that the main army had reached Hengshui.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen reported that the main army had reached Hengshui.

sentences.zh: 己亥，奏獲鄭州刺史趙思恭。

translations.literal: On jihai, he reported the capture of Zhao Sigong, Prefect of Zheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, he reported the capture of Zhao Sigong, prefect of Zhengzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，奏大軍回至冀州。

translations.literal: On guimao, he reported that the main army had returned to Ji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, he reported that the main army had returned to Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 戶部侍郎顏衎上表，以母老乞解官就養。

translations.literal: Yan Yan, Vice Minister of Revenue, submitted a memorial requesting resignation to care for his aged mother.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Yan, vice minister of revenue, submitted a memorial requesting resignation to care for his aged mother.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以皇子齊州防禦使延煦為澶州節度使。

translations.literal: On wushen, the imperial prince Yanshu, Defense Commissioner of Qi Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Chan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, the imperial prince Yanshu, defense commissioner of Qizhou, was made military governor of Chanzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，密州上言，饑民殍者一千五百。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Mizhou reported that fifteen hundred famine victims had died of exposure.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Mizhou reported that fifteen hundred famine victims had died of exposure.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以瓜州刺史曹元忠為沙州留後。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Cao Yuanzhong, Prefect of Gua Prefecture, was made Garrison Deputy of Sha Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Cao Yuanzhong, prefect of Guazhou, was made garrison deputy of Shazhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛酉朔，李守貞自北班師到闕。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, first day xinyou, Li Shouzhen returned from the north, withdrew his troops, and arrived at court.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the first day (xinyou) of the fourth month, Li Shouzhen withdrew his troops from the north and arrived at court.

sentences.zh: 太原奏，吐渾白可久奔歸契丹，諸侯咸有異志。

translations.literal: Taiyuan reported that the Tuyuhun Bai Kejiu had fled to submit to the Khitan, and that the various lords all harbored contrary designs.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan reported that the Tuyuhun Bai Kejiu had fled to submit to the Khitan, and that the various lords all harbored contrary designs.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，宰臣詣寺觀禱雨。

translations.literal: On yihai, the chief ministers went to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the chief ministers went to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 曹州奏，部民相次饑死凡三千人。

translations.literal: Caozhou reported that in succession three thousand local people had died of famine.
translations.idiomatic: Caozhou reported that in succession three thousand local people had died of famine.

sentences.zh: 時河南、河北大饑，殍名甚眾，沂、密、兗、鄆寇盜群起，所在屯聚，剽劫縣邑，吏不能禁。

translations.literal: At the time Henan and Hebei suffered great famine; corpses of the starved were very numerous; in Yi, Mi, Yan, and Yun bandits rose in groups, gathering everywhere, plundering counties and towns, and officials could not restrain them.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Henan and Hebei suffered great famine; corpses of the starved were very numerous; in Yi, Mi, Yan, and Yun bandits rose in groups, gathering everywhere, plundering counties and towns, and officials could not restrain them.

sentences.zh: 兗州節度使安審琦出兵捕逐，為賊所敗。

translations.literal: An Shenqi, Military Governor of Yan Prefecture, sent troops to pursue and capture them but was defeated by the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: An Shenqi, military governor of Yanzhou, sent troops to pursue and capture them but was defeated by the bandits.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，幸相國寺禱雨。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the Emperor visited Xiangguo Temple to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Emperor visited Xiangguo Temple to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 皇子延煦與晉昌軍節度使趙在禮結婚，命宗正卿石光贊主之。

translations.literal: The imperial prince Yanshu married the daughter of Zhao Zaili, Military Governor of the Jinchang Army; the Director of the Imperial Clan Shi Guangzan was ordered to preside.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial prince Yanshu married the daughter of Zhao Zaili, military governor of the Jinchang Army; Shi Guangzan, director of the Imperial Clan, was ordered to preside.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅朔，以兵部郎中劉皞為太府卿。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, first day gengyin, Liu Hao, Director of the Bureau of War, was made Chancellor of the Directorate of the Granary.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the first day (gengyin), Liu Hao, director of the Bureau of War, was made chancellor of the Directorate of the Granary.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以前同州節度使馮道為鄧州節度使。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Feng Dao, former Military Governor of Tong Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Feng Dao, former military governor of Tongzhou, was made military governor of Dengzhou.

sentences.zh: 定州奏，部民相次擄殺流移，約五千餘戶。

translations.literal: Ding Prefecture reported that local people were successively abducted, killed, or displaced, about more than five thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Dingzhou reported that local people were successively abducted, killed, or displaced, totaling more than five thousand households.

sentences.zh: 青州奏，全家殍死者一百一十二戶。

translations.literal: Qing Prefecture reported one hundred twelve households in which entire families had died of starvation.
translations.idiomatic: Qingzhou reported one hundred twelve households in which entire families had died of starvation.

sentences.zh: 沂州奏，淮南遣海州刺史領兵一千五百人，應接賊頭常知及。

translations.literal: Yizhou reported that Huainan had sent the Prefect of Hai Prefecture leading fifteen hundred troops to engage the bandit leader Chang Zhiji.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhou reported that Huainan had sent the prefect of Haizhou leading fifteen hundred troops to engage the bandit leader Chang Zhiji.

sentences.zh: 詔兗州安審琦領兵捕逐。

translations.literal: An edict ordered An Shenqi of Yan Prefecture to lead troops in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered An Shenqi of Yanzhou to lead troops in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以前太子賓客韋勛為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Wei Xun, former Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Wei Xun, former mentor of the heir apparent, was made mentor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 兗州安審琦奏，淮賊抽退，賊頭常知及與相次首領武約等並乞歸命。

translations.literal: An Shenqi of Yan Prefecture reported that the Huai bandits had withdrawn; the bandit leader Chang Zhiji and successive chiefs including Wu Yue all sought to submit.
translations.idiomatic: An Shenqi of Yanzhou reported that the Huai bandits had withdrawn; the bandit leader Chang Zhiji and successive chiefs including Wu Yue all sought to submit.

sentences.zh: 丁未，幸大年莊，遊船習射。

translations.literal: On dingwei, the Emperor visited Danian Manor, going out on boats to practice archery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, the Emperor visited Danian Manor, going out on boats to practice archery.

sentences.zh: 帝醉甚，賜群官器帛過差，夜分方歸內。

translations.literal: The Emperor was very drunk; gifts of vessels and silks to the officials exceeded proper measure, and only at midnight did he return to the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was very drunk; gifts of vessels and silks to the officials exceeded proper measure, and only at midnight did he return to the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以鄜州留後李殷為定州節度使。

translations.literal: On wushen, Li Yin, Garrison Deputy of Yong Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Ding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Li Yin, garrison deputy of Yongzhou, was made military governor of Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔皇甫遇為北面行營都部署，張彥澤為副，李殷為都監，領兵赴易、定等州，尋止其行。

translations.literal: On xinhai, an edict made Huangfu Yu overall commander of the Northern Expeditionary Command, Zhang Yanze deputy, and Li Yin chief overseer, to lead troops to Yi, Ding, and other prefectures; soon their march was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, an edict made Huangfu Yu overall commander of the northern expeditionary command, Zhang Yanze deputy, and Li Yin chief overseer, to lead troops to Yi, Ding, and other prefectures; soon their march was halted.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以貝州留後梁漢璋為貝州節度使，以左神武統軍郭謹為鄜州節度使。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Liang Hanzhang, Garrison Deputy of Bei Prefecture, was made Military Governor of Bei Prefecture; Guo Jin, Commander of the Left Divine Martial Army, was made Military Governor of Yong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Liang Hanzhang, garrison deputy of Beizhou, was made military governor of Beizhou; Guo Jin, commander of the Left Divine Martial Army, was made military governor of Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申朔，登州奏，文登縣部內有銅佛像四、瓷佛像十，自地踴出。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, first day gengshen, Deng Prefecture reported that within Wendeng County four bronze Buddha images and ten porcelain Buddha images had sprung up from the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the first day (gengshen), Dengzhou reported that within Wendeng County four bronze Buddha images and ten porcelain Buddha images had sprung up from the ground.

sentences.zh: 狼山招收指揮使孫方簡叛，據狼山歸契丹。

translations.literal: Sun Fangjian, Commander of Recruitment at Langshan, rebelled, seized Langshan, and submitted to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Fangjian, commander of recruitment at Langshan, rebelled, seized Langshan, and submitted to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔諸道不得橫薦官僚，如本處幕府有闕，即得奏薦。

translations.literal: On yichou, an edict forbade the various circuits from indiscriminately recommending officials; only when a post in the local staff office was vacant might they memorialize a recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, an edict forbade the various circuits from indiscriminately recommending officials; only when a post in the local staff office was vacant might they memorialize a recommendation.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以前昭義軍節度使李從敏為河陽節度使，以河陽節度使兼侍衛步軍都指揮使馮暉為靈州節度使。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Li Congmin, former Military Governor of the Zhaoyi Army, was made Military Governor of Heyang; Feng Hui, Military Governor of Heyang and Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Infantry, was made Military Governor of Ling Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Li Congmin, former military governor of the Zhaoyi Army, was made military governor of Heyang; Feng Hui, military governor of Heyang and commander-in-chief of the palace infantry, was made military governor of Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以鄆州節度使兼侍衛親軍都指揮使高行周為宋州節度使，加兼中書令，充北面行營副都統；

translations.literal: On renwu, Gao Xingzhou, Military Governor of Yun Prefecture and Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard, was made Military Governor of Song Prefecture, additionally made Grand Councilor, and appointed Deputy Overall Commander of the Northern Expeditionary Command;
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Gao Xingzhou, military governor of Yunzhou and commander-in-chief of the palace guard, was made military governor of Songzhou, additionally made grand councilor, and appointed deputy overall commander of the northern expeditionary command;

sentences.zh: 以宋州節度使、侍衛親軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Military Governor of Song Prefecture, Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Military governor of Songzhou, commander-in-chief of the palace guard.

sentences.zh: （案：以下有闕文。）〉

translations.literal: (Note: text missing below.)]
translations.idiomatic: (Note: text missing below.)]

sentences.zh: 定州奏，蕃寇壓境。

translations.literal: Ding Prefecture reported that barbarian raiders were pressing the border.
translations.idiomatic: Dingzhou reported that barbarian raiders were pressing the border.

sentences.zh: 詔李守貞為北面行營都部署，滑州皇甫遇為副，相州張彥澤充馬軍都指揮使，定州李殷充步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: An edict made Li Shouzhen overall commander of the Northern Expeditionary Command, Huangfu Yu of Huazhou deputy, Zhang Yanze of Xiang Prefecture Commander-in-Chief of the Cavalry, and Li Yin of Ding Prefecture Commander-in-Chief of the Infantry.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Li Shouzhen overall commander of the northern expeditionary command, Huangfu Yu of Huazhou deputy, Zhang Yanze of Xiang Prefecture commander-in-chief of the cavalry, and Li Yin of Ding Prefecture commander-in-chief of the infantry.

sentences.zh: 七月壬辰，以禮部尚書王延為刑部尚書，以工部尚書王松為禮部尚書，以太常卿龍敏為工部尚書，以左丞李慎儀為太常卿，以吏部侍郎張昭遠為左丞，以右丞李詳為吏部侍郎，以前義州刺史李玘為右丞。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on renchen, Wang Yan, Minister of Rites, was made Minister of Justice; Wang Song, Minister of Works, was made Minister of Rites; Long Min, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Minister of Works; Li Shenyi, Left Vice Director, was made Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of Personnel, was made Left Vice Director; Li Xiang, Right Vice Director, was made Vice Minister of Personnel; Li Qi, former Prefect of Yi Prefecture, was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renchen, Wang Yan, minister of rites, was made minister of justice; Wang Song, minister of works, was made minister of rites; Long Min, director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made minister of works; Li Shenyi, left vice director, was made director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; Zhang Zhaoyuan, vice minister of personnel, was made left vice director; Li Xiang, right vice director, was made vice minister of personnel; and Li Qi, former prefect of Yizhou, was made right vice director.

sentences.zh: 前晉昌軍節度使安彥威薨，輟朝，贈太師。

translations.literal: An Yanwei, former Military Governor of the Jinchang Army, died; court audiences were suspended; he was posthumously made Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: An Yanwei, former military governor of the Jinchang Army, died; court audiences were suspended, and he was posthumously made grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 丙申，兩浙節度使、吳越國王錢宏佐加守太師，北京留守、河東節度使、北平王劉知遠加守太尉。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Qian Hongzuo, Military Governor of Liangzhe and King of Wuyue, was additionally made Acting Grand Mentor; Liu Zhiyuan, Garrison Commander of the Northern Capital, Military Governor of Hedong, and Prince of Beiping, was additionally made Acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Qian Hongzuo, military governor of Liangzhe and king of Wuyue, was additionally made acting grand mentor; Liu Zhiyuan, garrison commander of the Northern Capital, military governor of Hedong, and Prince of Beiping, was additionally made acting grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 滄州奏，蕃寇攻饒安縣。

translations.literal: Cang Prefecture reported that barbarian raiders were attacking Rao'an County.
translations.idiomatic: Cangzhou reported that barbarian raiders were attacking Rao'an County.

sentences.zh: 楊劉口河決西岸，水闊四十里。

translations.literal: The Yellow River burst its west bank at Yangliukou; the water spread forty li wide.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River burst its west bank at Yangliukou; the water spread forty li wide.

sentences.zh: 以前鄧州節度使劉景巖為太子太師致仕。

translations.literal: Liu Jingyan, former Military Governor of Deng Prefecture, was made Retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jingyan, former military governor of Dengzhou, was made retired grand preceptor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，宋州谷熟縣河水雨水一概東流，漂沒秋稼。

translations.literal: On xinhai, in Gushu County of Song Prefecture, river water and rain together flowed east, sweeping away the autumn crops.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, in Gushu County of Songzhou, river water and rain together poured eastward and washed away the autumn crops.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，大理卿李專美卒。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Li Zhuanmei, Director of the Court of Judicial Review, died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Li Zhuanmei, director of the Court of Judicial Review, died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔偽清泰朝經削奪官爵朱宏昭、馮赟、康義誠、王思同、藥彥稠等，並復其官爵。

translations.literal: On wuwu, an edict restored the offices and titles of Zhu Hongzhao, Feng Yun, Kang Yicheng, Wang Sitong, Yao Yanchou, and others, who had been stripped under the false Qingtai reign.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, an edict restored the offices and titles of Zhu Hongzhao, Feng Yun, Kang Yicheng, Wang Sitong, Yao Yanchou, and others who had been stripped under the illegitimate Qingtai reign.

sentences.zh: 自夏初至是，河南、河北諸州郡餓死者數萬人，群盜蜂起，剽略縣鎮，霖雨不止，川澤泛漲，損害秋稼。

translations.literal: From early summer until this time, in the prefectures of Henan and Hebei tens of thousands died of starvation; bandits rose in swarms and plundered counties and towns; incessant rains caused rivers and marshes to overflow and damaged the autumn crops.
translations.idiomatic: From early summer until now, tens of thousands had starved to death in Henan and Hebei; bandits swarmed and plundered counties and towns; unending rains flooded rivers and marshes and ruined the autumn harvest.

sentences.zh: 八月己未朔，以左諫議大夫裴羽為給事中。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, first day jiwei, Pei Yu, Left Remonstrance Grand Master, was made Attendant-in-Ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day (jiwei) of the eighth month, Pei Yu, left remonstrance grand master, was appointed attendant-in-ordinary.

sentences.zh: 庚申，李守貞、皇甫遇駐軍定州。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Li Shouzhen and Huangfu Yu encamped their armies at Ding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Li Shouzhen and Huangfu Yu encamped their armies at Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，幸南莊，召從臣宴樂，至暮還宮。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the Emperor visited the Southern Villa, summoned his attending ministers for feasting and music, and returned to the palace at dusk.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Emperor visited the Southern Villa, summoned his ministers for feasting and music, and returned to the palace at dusk.

sentences.zh: 詔潞州運糧十三萬赴恒州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Lu Prefecture to transport 130,000 units of grain to Heng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Luzhou to transport 130,000 units of grain to Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以右散騎常侍張煦為青州刺史。

translations.literal: On guihai, Zhang Xu, Right Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, was made Prefect of Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Zhang Xu, right attendant of the cavalry, was appointed prefect of Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 李守貞奏，大軍至望都縣，相次至長城北，遇敵千餘騎，轉鬥四十里，斬蕃將解裏相公。

translations.literal: Li Shouzhen reported that the main army reached Wangdu County, then in succession reached the northern wall of the Long Wall, encountered more than a thousand enemy horsemen, fought for forty li, and beheaded the barbarian general Xieli Xianggong.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shouzhen reported that the main army reached Wangdu County and then the northern Long Wall, where it met more than a thousand enemy horsemen; after fighting for forty li, it beheaded the barbarian general Xieli Xianggong.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔班師。

translations.literal: On dingmao, an edict ordered withdrawal of the army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, an edict ordered the army to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以前亳州防禦使邊蔚為戶部侍郎；

translations.literal: On gengwu, Bian Wei, former Defense Commissioner of Bo Prefecture, was made Vice Minister of Revenue;
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Bian Wei, former defense commissioner of Bozhou, was made vice minister of revenue;

sentences.zh: 以刑部侍郎李式為戶部侍郎，充三司副使；

translations.literal: Li Shi, Vice Minister of Justice, was made Vice Minister of Revenue and served as Deputy Commissioner of the Three Departments;
translations.idiomatic: Li Shi, vice minister of justice, became vice minister of revenue and deputy commissioner of the Three Departments;

sentences.zh: 以禮部侍郎盧價為刑部侍郎；

translations.literal: Lu Jia, Vice Minister of Rites, was made Vice Minister of Justice;
translations.idiomatic: Lu Jia, vice minister of rites, became vice minister of justice;

sentences.zh: 以樞密直學士、左散騎常侍邊光範為禮部侍郎充職。

translations.literal: Bian Guangfan, Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, was made Vice Minister of Rites while continuing in office.
translations.idiomatic: Bian Guangfan, academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and left attendant of the cavalry, was made vice minister of rites while retaining his duties.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·邊光範傳》：少帝以光範藩邸舊僚，待遇尤厚。

translations.literal: (Biography of Bian Guangfan in the History of Song: The Young Emperor, because Guangfan was an old associate from the princely residence, treated him with especial favor.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Biography of Bian Guangfan in the History of Song: Because Guangfan had been an old associate in the princely residence, the Young Emperor treated him with especial favor.

sentences.zh: 因遊宴，見光範位翰林學士下，即日拜尚書禮部侍郎、知制誥，充翰林學士，仍直樞密使院。）〉

translations.literal: At a pleasure excursion and feast, seeing Guangfan ranked below the Hanlin academicians, that same day he was appointed Vice Minister of Rites in the Department of State Affairs with charge of drafting edicts, made Hanlin Academician, and still served in the Bureau of Military Affairs.)]
translations.idiomatic: At a pleasure outing, seeing Guangfan seated below the Hanlin academicians, the Emperor that same day appointed him vice minister of rites with charge of drafting edicts, made him a Hanlin academician, and kept him on duty at the Bureau of Military Affairs.)]

sentences.zh: 辛未，以右龍武統軍周密為延州節度使。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Zhou Mi, Commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army, was made Military Governor of Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Zhou Mi, commander of the Right Dragon Martial Army, was appointed military governor of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，河東節度使劉知遠奏，誅吐渾大首領白承福、白鐵匱、赫連海龍等，並夷其族凡四百口，蓋利其孳畜財寶也，人皆冤之。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Liu Zhiyuan, Military Governor of Hedong, reported that he had executed the great Tuyuhun leaders Bai Chengfu, Bai Tiegui, Helian Hailong, and others, and exterminated their clans—four hundred persons in all—because he coveted their livestock and treasure; all considered it an injustice.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Liu Zhiyuan of Hedong reported that he had executed the great Tuyuhun leaders Bai Chengfu, Bai Tiegui, Helian Hailong, and others and exterminated their clans—four hundred people in all—coveting their livestock and treasure; the act was widely regarded as unjust.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以大理少卿劇可久為大理卿。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Ju Kejiu, Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review, was made Director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Ju Kejiu, vice director of the Court of Judicial Review, was appointed director.

sentences.zh: 棣州刺史慕容彥超削奪在身官爵，房州安置，坐前任濮州擅出省倉麥及私賣官面，準法處死，太原節度使劉知遠上表救之，故貸其死。

translations.literal: Murong Yanchao, Prefect of Di Prefecture, was stripped of his current offices and titles and settled in Fang Prefecture, because while previously in Pu Prefecture he had unauthorizedly removed wheat from the provincial granary and privately sold official flour; by law he should have been executed, but Liu Zhiyuan, Military Governor of Taiyuan, memorialized to save him, and therefore his death was spared.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Yanchao, prefect of Dizhou, was stripped of his offices and settled in Fangzhou for having, while previously in Puzhou, unauthorizedly taken wheat from the provincial granary and privately sold official flour; by law he deserved death, but Liu Zhiyuan of Taiyuan memorialized on his behalf, and his life was spared.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，靈州馮暉奏，與威州刺史藥元福於威州土橋西一百里遇吐蕃七千餘人，大破之，斬首千餘級。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Feng Hui of Ling Prefecture reported that with Yao Yuanfu, Prefect of Wei Prefecture, one hundred li west of the earthen bridge at Wei Prefecture they encountered more than seven thousand Tibetans, routed them utterly, and took more than a thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Feng Hui of Lingzhou reported that with Wei Prefect Yao Yuanfu, one hundred li west of the earthen bridge at Weizhou, he had routed more than seven thousand Tibetans and taken more than a thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 是月，秦州雨，兩旬不止，鄴都雨水一丈，洛京、鄭州、貝州大水，鄴都、夏津臨清兩縣，餓死民凡三千三百。
