translations.literal: That month, Qin Prefecture rained without cease for twenty days; at the Ye capital rainwater reached one zhang; Luoyang, Zheng, and Bei Prefectures suffered great floods; in the two counties of Xiajin and Linqing under the Ye capital, 3,300 commoners starved to death.
translations.idiomatic: That month Qinzhou rained for twenty days without cease; at the Ye capital rainwater stood one zhang deep; Luoyang, Zhengzhou, and Beizhou were inundated; and in Xiajin and Linqing counties under the Ye capital, 3,300 people starved to death.

sentences.zh: 盜入臨濮、費縣。

translations.literal: Bandits entered Linpu and Fei counties.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits raided Linpu and Fei counties.

sentences.zh: 秋九月壬辰，鄆州節度使、侍衛親軍都指揮使李守貞加兼侍中，滑州節度使皇甫遇進封邠國公，相州節度使張彥澤加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: In autumn, the ninth month, on renchen, Li Shouzhen, Military Governor of Yan Prefecture and Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard, was additionally made Palace Attendant; Huangfu Yu, Military Governor of Hua Prefecture, was advanced to Duke of Bin; Zhang Yanzhe, Military Governor of Xiang Prefecture, was given the additional title of Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the ninth month of autumn, Li Shouzhen of Yanzhou, commander of the palace guard, was additionally made palace attendant; Huangfu Yu of Huazhou was advanced to Duke of Bin; and Zhang Yanzhe of Xiangzhou was given the additional title of grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以權知威武軍節度使李宏達為檢校太尉、同平章事，充福建節度使，知閩國事。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Li Hongda, provisional Military Governor of the Weiwu Army, was made Honorary Grand Preceptor and Associate Grand Councilor, appointed Military Governor of Fujian, and charged with affairs of the Min state.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Li Hongda, provisional governor of the Weiwu army, was made honorary grand preceptor and associate grand councilor, appointed military governor of Fujian, and charged with affairs of Min.

sentences.zh: 乙未，前商州刺史李俊賜自盡，坐與親妹奸及行劍斫殺女使，又殺部曲孫漢榮，強奸其妻，準法棄市，詔賜死於家。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Li Jun, former Prefect of Shang Prefecture, was granted death by his own hand, because he had committed incest with his younger sister by blood, drawn his sword and hacked to death a maidservant, also killed his retainer Sun Hanrong and raped his wife; by law he should have been executed in the marketplace, but an edict granted him death at home.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Li Jun, former prefect of Shangzhou, was ordered to take his own life for incest with his full sister, hacking a maidservant to death with his sword, killing his retainer Sun Hanrong, and raping the man's wife; though the law called for public execution, an edict allowed him to die at home.

sentences.zh: 己亥，張彥澤奏，破蕃賊於定州界，斬首二十餘級，追襲百餘里，生擒蕃將四人，摘得金耳環二副進呈。

translations.literal: On jihai, Zhang Yanzhe reported that he had defeated barbarian bandits on the border of Ding Prefecture, taken more than twenty heads, pursued for more than a hundred li, captured four barbarian generals alive, and presented two pairs of gold earrings taken as trophies.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Zhang Yanzhe reported defeating barbarian raiders on the Dingzhou border, taking more than twenty heads, pursuing them over a hundred li, capturing four barbarian generals alive, and presenting two pairs of gold earrings as trophies.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太原奏，破契丹於楊武谷，殺七千餘人。

translations.literal: On guimao, Taiyuan reported that the Khitan had been defeated at Yangwu Valley and more than seven thousand killed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Taiyuan reported a victory over the Khitan at Yangwu Valley with more than seven thousand killed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以天策上將軍、江南諸道都統、楚王馬希範兼諸道兵馬都元帥。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Ma Xifan, General-in-Chief of the Heavenly Stratagem, Overall Commander of the Jiangnan Circuits, and King of Chu, was additionally made Overall Commander of Troops and Horses of All Circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Ma Xifan, general-in-chief of the Heavenly Stratagem, overall commander of the Jiangnan circuits, and king of Chu, was additionally made overall commander of troops and horses for all circuits.

sentences.zh: 詔開封府，以霖雨不止，應京城公私僦舍錢放一月。

translations.literal: An edict to the Kaifeng administration, because incessant rains continued, ordered that public and private rental payments in the capital be remitted for one month.
translations.idiomatic: An edict to Kaifeng, because the rains would not cease, remitted public and private rental payments in the capital for one month.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔安審琦率兵赴鄴都，皇甫遇赴相州。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict ordered An Shenqi to lead troops to the Ye capital and Huangfu Yu to Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, an edict ordered An Shenqi to lead troops to the Ye capital and Huangfu Yu to Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以太子少保楊凝式為太子少傅，以刑部尚書王延為太子少保，前潁州團練使竇貞固為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Yang Ningshi, Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent; Wang Yan, Minister of Justice, was made Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent; Dou Zhengu, former Training Commissioner of Ying Prefecture, was made Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Yang Ningshi moved from junior mentor to junior tutor of the heir apparent; Wang Yan from minister of justice to junior mentor; and Dou Zhengu, former training commissioner of Yingzhou, became minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 是月，河南、河北、關西諸州奏，大水霖雨不止，溝河泛濫，水入城郭及損害秋稼。

translations.literal: That month, the prefectures of Henan, Hebei, and Guanxi reported that great floods and incessant rains caused ditches and rivers to overflow, water entered cities and towns, and the autumn crops were damaged.
translations.idiomatic: That month Henan, Hebei, and Guanxi reported great floods and unending rain, overflowing ditches and rivers, inundation of cities and towns, and damage to the autumn harvest.

sentences.zh: 是月，契丹瀛州刺史詐為書與樂壽將軍王巒，願以本城歸順，且言城中蕃軍不滿千人，請朝廷發軍襲取之，己為內應。

translations.literal: That month, the Khitan prefect of Ying Prefecture forged a letter to Wang Luan, general of Leshou, offering to surrender the city, stating that barbarian troops in the city numbered fewer than a thousand, requesting that the court send an army to seize it while he served as insider.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Khitan prefect of Yingzhou forged a letter to Wang Luan, general of Leshou, offering to surrender the city, claiming fewer than a thousand barbarian troops inside, and asking the court to send an army to seize it while he acted as insider.

sentences.zh: 又云：「今秋苦雨，川澤漲溢，自瓦橋已北，水勢無際。

translations.literal: It also said: "This autumn the rains have been bitter; rivers and marshes have swollen and overflowed; from Waqiao northward the waters are boundless.
translations.idiomatic: It also said: "This autumn the rains have been relentless; rivers and marshes have overflowed; from Waqiao northward the waters know no bound.

sentences.zh: 契丹已歸本國，若聞南夏有變，地遠阻水，雖欲奔命，無能及也。

translations.literal: The Khitan have already returned to their own country; if they hear of trouble in the Southern Court, the distance and the barrier of water mean that even if they wished to hurry to the rescue, they could not arrive in time."
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan have already returned home; if they hear of trouble in the south, distance and floodwaters will keep them from arriving in time even if they wished to hurry to the rescue."

sentences.zh: 」又，巒繼有密奏，苦言瀛、鄚可取之狀。

translations.literal: Luan also sent a secret memorial urgently describing how Ying and Mo could be taken.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Luan also sent secret memorials urgently arguing that Yingzhou and Mozhou could be taken.

sentences.zh: 先是，前歲中車駕駐於河上，曾遣邊將遺書於幽州趙延壽，勸令歸國，延壽尋有報命，依違而已。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the previous year when the imperial carriage was stationed on the river, a frontier general had been sent with a letter to Zhao Yanshou in Youzhou urging him to return to the realm; Yanshou soon sent a reply, but it was evasive and noncommittal.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the imperial carriage had been stationed on the river the year before, a frontier general was sent with a letter to Zhao Yanshou in Youzhou urging his return; Yanshou replied, but evasively and without commitment.

sentences.zh: 是歲三月，復遣鄴都杜威致書於延壽，且述朝旨，啖以厚利，仍遣洺州軍將趙行實賫書而往，潛申款密。

translations.literal: In the third month of this year, Du Wei of the Ye capital was again sent with a letter to Yanshou, setting forth the court's intent and tempting him with rich rewards; the Luozhou military officer Zhao Xingshi was also sent bearing the letter to convey secret pledges of goodwill.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of this year Du Wei of the Ye capital was again sent with a letter to Yanshou, stating the court's intent and tempting him with rich rewards; the Luozhou officer Zhao Xingshi carried the letter and conveyed secret pledges of goodwill.

sentences.zh: 行實曾事延壽，故遣之。

translations.literal: Xingshi had once served Yanshou, and therefore was sent.
translations.idiomatic: Xingshi had once served under Yanshou, and for that reason was chosen.

sentences.zh: 七月，行實自燕回，得延壽書，且言：「久陷邊庭，願歸中國，乞發大軍應接，即拔身南去。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Xingshi returned from Yan with a letter from Yanshou, which also said: "Long trapped on the frontier, I wish to return to China; I beg that a great army be sent to meet me, and I will at once withdraw southward."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Xingshi returned from Yan with Yanshou's letter, which said: "Long trapped on the frontier, I wish to return to China; send a great army to meet me, and I will withdraw south at once."

sentences.zh: 」敘致懇切，辭旨綿密，時朝廷欣然從之，復遣趙行實計會延壽大軍應接之所。

translations.literal: The tone was earnest and the wording close and careful; the court at the time gladly assented and again sent Zhao Xingshi to arrange with Yanshou the place where the great army should meet him.
translations.idiomatic: The tone was earnest and the wording careful; the court gladly assented and again sent Zhao Xingshi to arrange with Yanshou where the great army should meet him.

sentences.zh: 有瀛州大將遣所親賫蠟書至闕下，告雲欲謀翻變，以本城歸命。

translations.literal: A great general of Ying Prefecture sent a close associate bearing a sealed wax letter to the court, reporting that he wished to plot defection and surrender the city.
translations.idiomatic: A senior general of Yingzhou sent a close associate with a sealed wax letter to court, reporting his intent to defect and surrender the city.

sentences.zh: 未幾，會彼有告變者，事不果就。

translations.literal: Before long, someone there reported the plot, and the affair did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Before long someone there exposed the plot, and the affair came to nothing.

sentences.zh: 至是，瀛州守將劉延祚受契丹之命，詐輸誠款，以誘我軍，國家深以為信，遂有出師之議。

translations.literal: At this time, Liu Yanzuo, garrison commander of Ying Prefecture, on Khitan orders feigned sincere submission to lure our army; the state placed deep trust in this, and therefore the discussion of dispatching troops arose.
translations.idiomatic: Now Liu Yanzuo, garrison commander of Yingzhou, on Khitan orders feigned submission to lure our army; the court trusted him deeply, and the debate over dispatching troops began.
